endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: mt_fwp_whitaker_bridge_fas mt-fwp-39753902: Montana FWP identifies Whitaker Bridge Fishing Access Site, publishes its latitude/longitude and lists a concrete ramp. Retain the published location as a public access-area anchor; the record does not claim that this coordinate is the surveyed ramp toe or exact waterline.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (mt_fwp_whitaker_bridge_fas mt-fwp-39753902) on Blackfoot River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.

endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: montana_fwp_angevine_hand_launch_river_edge_20260918 montana-fwp-angevine-hand-launch-water-edge: Montana FWP identifies Angevine as a hand launch on the Blackfoot River and gives the site location at 46.89663,-113.76333. FWP GIS layer 2 defines the 13.0149-acre public Angevine boundary; the selected point lies within that boundary at its Blackfoot River edge. The previous route coordinate was 275.5 feet from NHD waterbody geometry and 329.8 feet from the matched flowline. The replacement uses the nearest NHD shoreline point, checked against current Google Maps aerial imagery and the public parcel. It is imagery-derived with 75-foot uncertainty, not a surveyed FWP water-entry coordinate.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the exact named authoritative water-entry control (montana_fwp_angevine_hand_launch_river_edge_20260918 montana-fwp-angevine-hand-launch-water-edge) on Blackfoot River; the 55 ft named-flowline offset reflects incomplete or generalized NHD coverage, not a proposed coordinate move.
